impact: A nonempty list or string supplied as front-matter columns produces the documented type warning but later raises AttributeError when automatic widths call items. Rendering aborts instead of following the documented warn-and-continue behavior. Invalid metadata must fall back safely without changing established valid mappings.
resolution: Resolved by normalizing front-matter columns overrides at the automatic-width consumer boundary: apply_default_table_widths now accepts the value only when it is a dict and otherwise uses the established empty-override default. A parametrized regression matrix covers nonempty list, string, boolean, and integer values and proves output equals the no-override path. Existing integrated coverage verifies YAML parsing emits the documented warning and rendering continues with default widths; valid type and explicit-width mappings remain covered. Python 3.13 focused validation passed 76 tests, the full suite passed 125 tests, git diff --check passed, and final CODE_REVIEW lenses approved with full coverage and zero findings.
title: Mistyped columns metadata warns and then crashes
